import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# Data provided by the user
csv_data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# --- Data Preprocessing ---
# Fill missing 'Sleep Disorder' values with 'None'
df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None', inplace=True)

# Split 'Blood Pressure' into 'Systolic' and 'Diastolic' columns
df[['Systolic', 'Diastolic']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# --- Visualization ---
# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")

# Create a 2x2 subplot grid
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 14))
fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Analysis of Sleep and Health Factors', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Sleep Quality vs. Stress Level
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Stress Level',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Sleep Duration',
    style='Occupation',
    sizes=(150, 400),
    ax=axes[0, 0]
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Quality vs. Stress Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='medium')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Factors')

# Plot 2: Physical Activity vs. Heart Rate
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Physical Activity Level',
    y='Heart Rate',
    hue='BMI Category',
    size='Daily Steps',
    style='Sleep Disorder',
    sizes=(150, 400),
    ax=axes[0, 1]
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Physical Activity vs. Heart Rate', fontsize=14, fontweight='medium')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (min/day)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Factors')


# Plot 3: Sleep Duration by Occupation and BMI Category
sns.stripplot(
    data=df,
    x='Occupation',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    hue='BMI Category',
    dodge=True,
    size=12,
    alpha=0.8,
    linewidth=1,
    edgecolor='gray',
    ax=axes[1, 0]
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='medium')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)


# Plot 4: Blood Pressure Distribution by Sleep Disorder
# Reshape data for plotting both Systolic and Diastolic
bp_melted = df.melt(
    id_vars=['Person ID', 'Sleep Disorder'],
    value_vars=['Systolic', 'Diastolic'],
    var_name='BP Type',
    value_name='Value'
)
sns.barplot(
    data=bp_melted,
    x='Sleep Disorder',
    y='Value',
    hue='BP Type',
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    palette='magma',
    ci=None
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Blood Pressure by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, fontweight='medium')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Blood Pressure (mmHg)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].legend(title='BP Type')


# Adjust layout and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
